record.question: The three districts which were created in 2008 Mizoram were
record.explanation: Answer B: Hnahthial, Saitual, Khawzawl. The three districts were Saitual, Khawzawl, and Hnahthial. Mizoram’s district history says they were formed in September 2008, though they only began functioning in 2019; thus the stem’s 2008 date is not erroneous. Reference: https://saitual.nic.in/history/; https://police.mizoram.gov.in/page/phq. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
